title: PREpiBind: Protein Representation-integrated Epitope-MHC Class II Binding Prediction
description:
PREpiBind is a dual-stream, joint-attention framework for peptide–MHC class II binding prediction. It holds one downstream architecture fixed so that ten protein representations — a substitution matrix, structure-prediction-derived features and protein language models — can be compared on equal terms.

This record archives the source snapshot of a tagged release: the model and its released checkpoint configurations, the preprocessing, embedding and analysis pipelines, the IEDB-derived training and evaluation datasets, and a runnable demo.

The code is MIT; the data is not. The record-level licence field cannot express both, so it reads "Other (Open)". Per-file terms are in data/LICENSE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md inside the archive. Note one standing condition: the IPD-IMGT/HLA chain sequences are redistributed by permission of Anthony Nolan, granted 24 September 2026, on the condition that they be contacted to review the agreement should this work become commercial or otherwise make profit.

The raw model predictions behind every reported number, and the IEDB export the datasets were built from, are archived separately at 10.5281/zenodo.22857373.
